verdict.rationale: Capsule's own Tracks feature sets up a series of tasks that each become active one after the other, which covers only the create-tasks part of the story; the evidence does not show event triggers, record updates, or notifications. Zapier is a third-party integration and earns no credit. missing for 10: event/condition-based triggers, automated record field updates, automated notifications, an in-depth workflow builder documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically

citations.quote: Use Tracks to set up a series of tasks that each become active one after the other.
